clearedSpotChecks.check: Task 1 (L-1127): 47 of the 774 jump sides of build/PoolManager.json were run by nothing, and the 22 math sides among them are unreachable by bounds that earlier lines enforce.
clearedSpotChecks.note: I listed the 47 sides from out/table.json (rows with nothing=true): 22 at PoolManager.sol:80, PoolManager.sol:110, Currency.sol:91 and 94, and 22 in math files. I disassembled build/PoolManager.json at the less obvious pcs. 18728 (attributed to ProtocolFeeLibrary.sol:15) is ISZERO of the divisor and a JUMPI to the Panic 0x12 block at 0x492c, so it is the compiler's division-by-zero test in a shared division helper. Its divisors are the constant 1_000_000 (Pool.sol:393), sqrtPriceAX96 after the zero check at SqrtPriceMath.sol:197-202 (line 209), and sqrtPX96 after SqrtPriceMath.sol:135-143 (line 52), so none is zero. 19792 (attributed to TickMath.sol:33) is SUB followed by SGT and a JUMPI, which is the checked int256 subtraction of Pool.sol:375 that the item argues under that line. 23677 is the zero-divisor test before MULMOD in the shared copy of mulDivRoundingUp (FullMath.sol:112), distinct from the 20942 copy at SqrtPriceMath.sol:105. The item argues only the copy at line 105. I checked the shared copy's callers: SqrtPriceMath.sol:47 (numerator1 + product >= numerator1 = L<<96 > 0), :71 (gt(numerator1, product) at :59-68), :208 (sqrtPriceBX96 >= sqrtPriceAX96 > 0), SwapMath.sol:74 (the ternary at :72 excludes feePips == MAX_SWAP_FEE) and SwapMath.sol:104 (Pool.sol:311-315 rejects exact output with swapFee >= MAX_SWAP_FEE). None passes a zero divisor. I also checked the bounds by hand. SqrtPriceMath.sol:59: the remaining output is below floor(floor(L*2^96*(sT-sC)/sT)/sC) (SwapMath.sol:90-91), so amount*sC < L*2^96 and the price cannot overflow. The quotient N*sC/(N - amount*sC) is strictly below sT, so its ceiling is at most sT. That is 'at most' rather than the item's 'below', and the uint160 cast at :71 holds either way. SqrtPriceMath.sol:109: amount <= floor(L*(sC-sT)/2^96) - 1 gives ceil(amount*2^96/L) <= sC - sT < sC. SqrtPriceMath.sol:135 and :164: with L = 0 the amount to the target is 0, so SwapMath.sol:69 and :91 take the target branch. SqrtPriceMath.sol:37 in the output copy: Pool.sol:344 leaves the loop when the remainder is 0. The callers of getAmount0Delta at SwapMath.sol:67, 86, 90 and 101 pass the lower price first. Two labels in the item's prose are imprecise (ProtocolFeeLibrary.sol:15 is not named, and TickMath.sol:33 stands for Pool.sol:375), but no reachable math side is left unrun.

clearedSpotChecks.check: Task 2: SqrtPriceMath.sol:105, rerun as 7 liquidity variants through eth_call on all 21 networks. All 7 revert with SafeCastOverflow at the int128 casts of Pool.sol:455-459, and every network matches the reference words.
clearedSpotChecks.note: I reran the 7 cases of out/run27b/allcases.json myself with the cycle 25 chainrun.py. Each was a separate eth_call carrying state overrides, with no transaction sent, against the networks.json RPCs of MegaETH (client mega-reth/v2.3.1-4499c42@mnet-ash-rpc-2, block 32931643) and HyperEVM ('hyperliquid evm Mainnet', block 52329499). Output is in cycles/027/theme-never-run-math-sides.verify/run27b. For every case, on both networks, the result words equal both the producer's saved chain-<cid>.json and the reference ref-<cid>.json. Word 1 is 0x93dafdf1, and I confirmed with the keccak in tools/opdiff/evm.py that this is keccak('SafeCastOverflow()')[:4]. Code: line 105 is taken only when amount > type(uint160).max (SqrtPriceMath.sol:103). It is reached only from getNextSqrtPriceFromOutput (SqrtPriceMath.sol:176), when the step stops short with amountOut = amountRemaining (SwapMath.sol:94-98). That step leaves amountSpecifiedRemaining = 0, so Pool.sol:455/459 casts amountSpecified >= 2^160 to int128, and SafeCast.sol:40-43 reverts. The rounding result of line 105 therefore never reaches a balance.

clearedSpotChecks.check: Task 4, MegaETH: in mega-evm v1.7.4 every arithmetic, shift, byte and comparison opcode is a compute_gas_ext wrapper that calls revm's handler unchanged.
clearedSpotChecks.note: I fetched https://raw.githubusercontent.com/megaeth-labs/mega-evm/v1.7.4/crates/mega-evm/src/evm/instructions.rs (3568 lines). Lines 862-889 map STOP through SAR, CLZ and KECCAK256 to compute_gas_ext::*. The wrap_op_compute_gas macro (around line 3019) reads gas_before, runs the original revm handler through run_inner_instruction_or_abort!, and charges static gas plus the gas used against the additional limit, without touching the stack. Around lines 3113-3124, each of add, mul, sub, div, sdiv, rem, smod, addmod, mulmod, exp, signextend, lt, gt, slt, sgt and eq wraps instructions::arithmetic::* or instructions::bitwise::* directly. As the item says, an exceeded compute-gas limit halts the frame and changes no word. Whether the closed mega-reth build links v1.7.4 is still open, and the item records that as a low lead.
